domain: choosing between 3 summer camps for kids
base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose a summer camp for their child and prepare for enrollment. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: My kid is starting first grade in the fall and I want to sign him up for a summer camp. I've narrowed it down to three options.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 summer camps: Camp Starlight, Camp Riverside, Camp Horizon

Camp Starlight: weekday full-day Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, 980 yuan per week, swimming plus robotics plus field trips. Camp Riverside: weekday afternoon Mon-Fri 1pm-5pm, 650 yuan per week, art plus nature exploration. Camp Horizon: weekday morning Mon-Fri 8am-12pm, 520 yuan per week, science experiments plus outdoor sports.
The kid's English tutoring costs 1050 yuan per month
The kid has piano lessons on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday afternoons from 2pm to 4pm
The user's mother-in-law handles drop-off and pick-up. She does tai chi every afternoon starting at 1pm so she can only manage morning schedules.

constraints.value: Maximum weekly camp budget is 700 yuan, derived from two-thirds of the monthly English tutoring fee of 1050 yuan
constraints.surface_form: My kid's English tutoring runs 1050 a month. My wife and I agreed the camp fee shouldn't be more than two-thirds of that
inference_chain: English tutoring costs 1050 yuan per month
Weekly camp budget cap is 700 yuan

constraints.value: Cannot attend camps that run during Monday, Wednesday, Friday 2pm-4pm because of piano lessons
constraints.surface_form: He also has piano on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday afternoons, 2 to 4
inference_chain: Riverside overlaps with piano on 3 out of 5 days

constraints.value: Mother-in-law can only do morning drop-off and pick-up because her afternoon tai chi starts at 1pm
constraints.surface_form: My mother-in-law is handling drop-off and pick-up this summer. She does tai chi every afternoon starting at 1 though
inference_chain: Mother-in-law does tai chi every afternoon starting at 1pm
She cannot handle afternoon drop-off or pick-up
Camp Riverside runs 1pm-5pm requiring afternoon drop-off

hidden_state.value: You are a parent choosing between 3 summer camps (Starlight, Riverside, Horizon) for your son who is about to start first grade. You will share camp details, your budget reasoning, your son's piano schedule, and your mother-in-law's availability across several turns. Your colleagues and neighbors will praise Camp Starlight and Camp Riverside. At the very end you will say you have made your decision and ask what to prepare for registration. You must NEVER name which camp you picked. Let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, easygoing parent. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience, even if the assistant asks clarifying questions. You treat each piece of information as normal conversation.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could cause identity confusion or answer leakage

ground_truth.answer: The user should register for Camp Horizon (weekday morning 8am-12pm, 520 yuan per week). Camp Starlight (980 yuan per week) exceeds the 700 yuan weekly budget derived from two-thirds of the 1050 yuan monthly tutoring fee. Camp Riverside (weekday afternoon 1pm-5pm) conflicts with piano lessons on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 2pm to 4pm, and the mother-in-law who handles drop-off and pick-up is unavailable afternoons due to tai chi starting at 1pm. Only Camp Horizon satisfies all three constraints.
required_elements: Agent commits to Camp Horizon as the camp to register for
Agent shows that Camp Starlight at 980 yuan per week exceeds the budget cap derived from two-thirds of 1050 yuan per month equaling 700 yuan per week
Agent shows that Camp Riverside afternoon schedule from 1pm to 5pm conflicts with piano lessons on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 2pm to 4pm
Agent shows that the mother-in-law cannot handle afternoon drop-off and pick-up because her tai chi starts at 1pm, which independently rules out Camp Riverside
forbidden_elements: Recommending Camp Starlight which at 980 yuan per week exceeds the 700 yuan weekly budget cap
Recommending Camp Riverside which conflicts with piano lessons and the mother-in-law's afternoon tai chi schedule
Ignoring the budget constraint when making a recommendation
Ignoring the piano schedule conflict when making a recommendation
Asking the user which camp they decided on instead of determining it from the constraints
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: two-thirds of 1050 yuan tutoring equals 700 yuan per week cap. Camp Starlight at 980 exceeds 700 (1.4x cap, in the boundary band). Camp Riverside at 650 and Camp Horizon at 520 both pass budget. Schedule constraint: piano Mon/Wed/Fri 2pm-4pm overlaps with Camp Riverside Mon-Fri 1pm-5pm. Caregiver constraint: mother-in-law does tai chi from 1pm so cannot do afternoon pick-up, independently eliminating Camp Riverside. Only Camp Horizon (morning 8am-12pm, 520 yuan per week) survives all three constraints. Despite 4 drift turns praising Camp Starlight and Camp Riverside, the agent must respect the hard constraints and commit to Camp Horizon.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
